candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that sets rewardsForA[recipient] to 0 before the external call in withdrawReward.
Change the external call value from amountToWithdraw to a fixed amount (1) inside withdrawReward.
Remove the _locked = false assignment at the end of the _nonReentrant modifier, permanently locking the contract after one call.
Delete the require statement that checks claimedBonus, causing unconditional execution.
Replace claimedBonus[recipient] = true; with claimedBonus[recipient] = false; so the bonus can be claimed repeatedly, changing rewardsForA and thus getFirstWithdrawalBonus.
Change rewardsForA[recipient] += 100; to rewardsForA[recipient] += 0; so no reward is added, causing getFirstWithdrawalBonus to differ.
Move claimedBonus[recipient] = true; before withdrawReward(recipient); so the bonus is marked claimed before withdrawal, changing state visible to getFirstWithdrawalBonus on reentry.
Delete the line withdrawReward(recipient); so the reward is never withdrawn, leaving rewardsForA unchanged and getFirstWithdrawalBonus observable values different.
